mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, merchant_code, merchant_name, merchant_type, parent_merchant_id, business_category, business_license, legal_person, contact_person, contact_phone, contact_email, address, province, city, district, longitude, latitude, status, timezone, created_at, updated_at FROM merchants WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id, merchant_code, merchant_name, merchant_type, parent_merchant_id, business_category, business_license, legal_person, contact_person, contact_phone, contact_email, address, province, city, district, longitude, latitude, status, timezone, created_at, updated_at FROM merchants WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE merchants SET merchant_name = #{merchantName}, contact_person = #{contactPerson}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, contact_email = #{contactEmail}, address = #{address}, province = #{province}, city = #{city}, timezone = #{timezone}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchants ( tenant_id, merchant_code, merchant_name, merchant_type, business_category, contact_person, contact_phone, contact_email, address, province, city, district, timezone, status ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{merchantCode}, #{merchantName}, #{merchantType}, #{businessCategory}, #{contactPerson}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactEmail}, #{address}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{timezone}, 'ACTIVE' )
